research_scope: Four contextual phrase aliases to ordinary underlying-set bijection, preserving structured homeomorphism, graph, cardinal and category conditions.

aliases.reason: The full source uses the underlying set-map condition of injectivity together with surjectivity, the same general bijection represented by the reviewed canonical phrase 'bijection'. A homeomorphism requires additional continuity of the inverse, a graph isomorphism requires edge preservation and reflection, and a Hom-set bijection in an adjunction may require naturality; none of these extra conditions is being silently aliased. Source phrase 'bijective' is precisely this shared mapping predicate.
